newsitem.title: USA: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S SUPER-G WINNER SCHIFFERER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S SUPER-G WINNER SCHIFFERER.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of the winner of the World Cup Finals men's Super-G race on Thursday:

World Cup wins: 1 Super-G at World Cup Finals in Vail. Other feats: Captured bronze medal in giant slalom at world championships in Sestriere. Came on strong towards end of season with second-place finishes in Super-G at Kvitjell and giant slalom in Shiga Kogen. Finished third in giant slalom in Adelboden. Surged to third place in final Super-G standings and stands seventh in the overall rankings.
